title: verify-dnd5e-srd-pack does not diff record-relationships.json
description: packages/core/scripts/verify-dnd5e-srd-pack/cli.ts (discovered while doing eshyra-jgxl F2/F3 work) diffs manifest.json/records.json, source-inventory.json, source-coverage.json, source-region-ledger.json, and field-provenance.json against a fresh importer run, but never touches record-relationships.json (packages/core/src/rules/packLoader.ts PACK_RECORD_RELATIONSHIPS_FILE). A content change to the curated recordRelationshipDeclarations.ts (e.g. a reason string, or a future declaration edit) can silently drift the committed record-relationships.json from what the importer would actually emit, with 'verify:dnd5e-srd-pack: committed pack matches importer output exactly' printed anyway. eshyra-jgxl hit this directly: updating five reason strings in recordRelationshipDeclarations.ts changed record-relationships.json but the verify script reported a clean match until the file was diffed by hand. Add a byte-diff of record-relationships.json to verify-dnd5e-srd-pack/cli.ts, mirroring how field-provenance.json is already compared, and add regression coverage.
